websiteUrl.title: Public website URL
websiteUrl.description: The public HTTP(S) site to process. Local and private-network targets are rejected.

maxPages.title: Maximum visible page results
maxPages.description: Upper limit on page results. This is the main run-cost control.

includeFullText.title: Generate llms-full.txt
includeFullText.description: Also create a combined clean-text file for review or RAG ingestion.

trackChanges.title: Compare with the previous successful run
trackChanges.description: Store a hashed manifest in your Apify account and report added, changed, unchanged, and possibly removed pages next time.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip URLs that robots.txt disallows for the crawler. Recommended for responsible public-site processing.

maxContentCharsPerPage.title: Maximum content characters per page
maxContentCharsPerPage.description: Truncate very long page content in llms-full.txt and the change fingerprint.
